release_notes:
Detect and heal partial schema imports, not just "> 10 tables"

The idempotency check for schema import used a fixed ">10 tables" threshold.
A prior run that fails partway through the SQL import (as happened after the
tbl_gf_email_settings fix) leaves a partial schema that still clears that bar,
so every later re-run of install.sh reports "already imported" and never
retries — the install looks successful with most of the app's tables missing.

Now compares against the actual CREATE TABLE count in the bundled template,
and drops + recreates the database before re-importing if the count is short.
